_comment: Infrastructure manifest v2 (§9.5, criterion 113). DO NOT hand-edit identities — generate with scripts/gen_manifest.py, which MEASURES the machine. Trust model: the phase gate (a) measures the live machine at check time, (b) verifies deployment_host against the operator's hash pin (hermes-supervise pin-manifest). Because certification never trusts this file's self-report, agents (Claude Code, Hermes) may freely create/refresh it and append facts — none of that can forge Phase-B provenance.

deployment_host._how: run ON THE SERVER once: python scripts/gen_manifest.py --declare-deployment-host --target-cpu znver5   (writes MEASURED machine_id; then pin: hermes-supervise pin-manifest)

current_machine._note: informational only; refreshed by gen_manifest.py; the gate measures live and ignores this block

facts.value: agent-writable provenance-stamped ledger (Helius plan, Jito status, CPU features); appended via gen_manifest.py --add-fact or the record_infra_fact MCP tool; appends never invalidate the pin
